title: Jamaican Beef Hash
description: A flavorful hash made with beef, onions, bell peppers, and a hint of Caribbean spice.
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the hash and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Sprinkle the flour and jerk seasoning over the top of the hash mixture and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the hash is lightly browned and crispy.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the hash to a serving dish and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
